Wrong pin? Try the other thin
pins next to it - only the right

BC-250 BOTTOM side - meter check for the power-button pad
Do this BEFORE soldering. Never let a probe touch two pins at once.
The exact idle voltage on your board is not verified - the drop to 0 V while the button is held is what identifies the pad.
